title: Saquon Barkley urges LeBron James to sign in Philadelphia, "be remembered forever"

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Saquon Barkley urges LeBron James to sign in Philadelphia, "be remembered forever"
sources.description: Two years ago, Saquon Barkley signed as a free agent in Philadelphia, won a championship in his first season there, and became one of the city's most beloved athletes.
